content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 5.2 a) ii) requires MSL to assist the transfer of responsibilities, and § 5.2 a) iii) requires return of IBM documentation and confidential material, but neither carries a committed period (assistance is open-ended; the return period is redacted "[*] Days"), and the chapeau limits the obligations to expiration or termination *for default*. Attachment 6 § 3(a) covers only MS Software Image media, and § 12.0 Transition Services is inbound-only and expired in 1998. That fails the TRANSITION fallback, so I proposed a single new § 5.2 d) giving at least 90 Days of transition assistance and export of IBM data within 30 Days after any expiration or termination — the shortest change meeting all three fallback elements, without volunteering the preferred six-month/certified-deletion terms.
